Alicia Gomez: Alicia Gomez: Let's anchor the discussion on scope and expected outcome. What has actually changed since the last check-in?
Noah Williams: Noah Williams: The current picture is the retry change is merged, but the reconciliation job is waiting on a data contract review. We have the staging dashboard shows 96 percent successful retries across the latest test batch, and the signal I am watching is the remaining blocker is the reconciliation schema sign-off.
Grace Kim: Grace Kim: My concern is a late schema change could invalidate the migration already prepared. If the ledger team must confirm the settlement-reference field, what do we tell the people relying on this work?
Daniel Foster: Daniel Foster: We can freeze the field names today and keep the optional metadata out of this release. We should keep whether the legacy partner feed needs a temporary compatibility field visible until that check is complete.
Alicia Gomez: Alicia Gomez: For the record, keep the retry change in the current sprint and move optional reconciliation metadata to the next sprint. Noah Williams will publish the schema diff and get a review from the ledger team by 3 p.m. tomorrow; whether the legacy partner feed needs a temporary compatibility field remains unresolved.
